original_analysis: Three fictional one-entry users give calendar D1 2/3 versus exact 24–48-hour D1 1/3 on identical complete logs. Endpoints, a 23h25m hour-flooring counterexample and an earlier data cutoff are explicit. Fixed-cohort, common-cutoff on-or-after monotonicity is a set relation, not a service observation.
